The class had organized a secret party for our friend, Nick that was leaving the school on 2 more weeks.

All started when Pat, the best friend of Nick, wanted to make the party in his house, most of the class disagree with that because the house of Pat is extremly little, they started to say him that his house was like a box.
Pat got very angree and sad.
Pat affected with this situation told Nick all the situation and the secret of the class.
At the beginning Nick got angree but then he forgive him because they were friend and each of one can trust on the other.
